ValidationRule.description: Ensures that the value of the complexity weight is only 1,2,3, or 4.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND($RecordType.Name = "NAS General Support Case", NAS_Complexity_Weight__c <> 0, NAS_Complexity_Weight__c <> 1, NAS_Complexity_Weight__c <> 2, NAS_Complexity_Weight__c <> 3, NAS_Complexity_Weight__c <> 4)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Complexity Weight field can only have following values: 1,2,3 or 4.
